title: Stalk normalization compared with normalization of its generic torsor
statement: Let $S$ be a normal integral Noetherian quasi-separated scheme and $c:C\to S$ a quasi-compact quasi-separated smooth morphism [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois]. Let $G$ be a finite group. Let $q:C_\eta\to\operatorname{Spec}k(S)$ and $j:C_\eta\to C$ exhibit the generic fibre, and let $Z\to C_\eta$ be a finite etale $G$-torsor [def-pc-fibre-product, def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois]. Let $U\subseteq S$ contain $\eta$ and let $P\to C_U$ be finite etale. Suppose $j_U:C_\eta\to C_U$ and $\psi:Z\to P$ exhibit a cartesian comparison, with $i_Uj_U=j$. Let $s\notin U$ satisfy: every $t$ specializing to $s$ and outside $U$ equals $s$. Suppose $A=\mathcal O_{S,s}$ is a discrete valuation ring (a nonfield local principal ideal domain). Set $a:\operatorname{Spec}A\to S$, $L=C\times_S\operatorname{Spec}A$, $d:L\to\operatorname{Spec}A$, $K=k(S)$ with its canonical fraction-field $A$-algebra structure, $b:\operatorname{Spec}K\to\operatorname{Spec}A$, and $L_K=L\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}K$. Let $N$ be the concrete relative normalization of $P\to C_U\to C$ [lem-weil-pbc-relative-normalization], and $n:N\times_C L\to L$ its pullback. There exists a finite etale $G$-torsor $W\to L_K$ and an isomorphism $\beta:N\times_C L\cong p.\mathrm{normalization}$, where $p:W\to L$ is the composite with $L_K\to L$, such that $\beta$ commutes with the structure maps to $L$. No assumption on invertibility of $|G|$, and no finiteness assumption on $n$, is made.

source.place: Tags 0EYJ (local reduction to the punctured spectrum), 0307 and 035I

proof.text: Construct gamma:L_K to C_eta by the universal property of the given generic-fibre square. The identity b followed by a equals S.fromSpecStalk(eta) is SpecMap_stalkSpecializes_fromSpecStalk. Projection identities give gamma followed by j equals p followed by g. Thus k=gamma followed by jU commutes with C_U to C. The local-generic-open lemma makes its square cartesian.

Base change Z along gamma with GaloisCover.exists_baseChange, obtaining W and rho. Paste its square horizontally with hpsi and vertically with the open pullback square. This gives IsPullback (rho followed by psi) (W.pi followed by p) (PA.hom followed by i_U) g. The resulting isoPullback identifies W.P with the concrete pullback of PA over L, compatibly with structure maps.

Apply stalk-base-change normalization to f=PA.hom followed by i_U. Transport normalization across isoPullback using normalizationDesc in both directions and normalization.hom_ext to prove their inverse identities. Compose the inverse stalk comparison with the inverse transported isomorphism. normalizationPullback_snd and normalizationDesc structure-map identities give the asserted equation over L.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0EYJ, 0307, 035I and 02KH; normalization universal property and affine comparison
